rationale: The agent found that cases sit mostly on plates 1-2 and controls on plates 3-4, and that the classifier is learning the plate rather than disease. It declined to report 0.82 as real performance. It backed this with measured numbers: plate alone gives AUROC 0.84, and plates 1-2 hold 51/60 cases versus 12/60 controls (about 85% vs 20%). Its proposed fixes match the key: randomize samples across plates and validate on an independently processed cohort.
